answer: All plastic targets exclude plastic packaging purchased or sold by businesses not fully integrated into Unilever's SAP system and exclude transport (tertiary) packaging. Plastic packaging purchased by collaborative manufacturers is also excluded, representing approximately 11% of plastic packaging purchased in the 26 countries. A multi-material component is not considered plastic packaging if plastic is not the single greatest material by weight.

excluded: plastic packaging purchased or sold by businesses not fully integrated into Unilever's SAP system
plastic packaging purchased by collaborative manufacturers
multi-material packaging where plastic is not the greatest material by weight
